## Problem and change

Explain what this fixes and how. Keep unrelated changes separate.

## Validation

List the commands/hardware you actually tested and the results. Mark anything
not tested, especially native emulation, VR controllers, AR and sleep/wake.

## Checklist

- [ ] No ROMs, saves, credentials, private logs or local machine configuration.
- [ ] No generated binaries, exports or build caches.
- [ ] Component licences/notices preserved; upstream changes explained.
- [ ] Relevant documentation/tests updated, or limitations noted.
